server.started: TRM Live UI v{version} is running
server.portInUse: Port {port} is in use. Close the other running TRM Live UI, or set another port in data/config.json.
server.noPack: No usable UI pack. Check the packs folder.
server.fallback: UI pack "{wanted}" cannot be used. Using "{used}" instead.

live.scenesNote: A click takes effect at once. Alt + a number key also works

content.sub: Click "Update" or press Ctrl + Enter when you are done.
content.discardBody: The text returns to what the overlay shows now.
content.none: The current UI pack has no text to edit.

presets.title: Presets
presets.loaded: Loaded "{name}". Check it, then click Update.
presets.sub: Save the current text on the Content page and load it again with one click.
presets.name: Name
presets.saveNote: This saves the text on the Content page. The current scene is not included.
presets.emptyDesc: Enter a name above to save the current text as a preset.
presets.replaceBody: A preset with the same name exists. Saving replaces it.

packs.madeWith: Made with TRM Live UI v{version}
packs.confirmDiscard: The Content page has unpublished changes. Switching discards them.
packs.scriptWarning: This pack contains {count} script(s) that run in the overlay and the control panel. Import packs only from sources you trust.
packs.replaceWarning: A UI pack with the same id exists. Importing replaces it, and the old one is backed up to data/backups.
packs.sub: Each UI pack is a complete overlay. Switch, import and export them here.
packs.listNote: The pack in use comes first
packs.confirmUseBody: The overlay changes to this UI at once.
packs.importBody: Version v{version}, made with TRM Live UI v{madeWith}.
packs.removeBody: It is moved to data/backups. Content and presets are kept.

banner.fallback: UI pack "{id}" cannot be used. See the reason in the UI library.
banner.fallbackTitle: The default UI is in use
banner.issuesTitle: The current UI pack has notices

settings.sub: Panel language, the addresses OBS needs, and version information.
settings.obsNote: Enter these two addresses in OBS
settings.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text instead.

request.offline: Cannot reach the local service. Make sure it is running.

config.invalidValue: The value for "{key}" is not valid.

preset.invalidName: A preset name must not be empty, must be at most 80 characters, and must not contain \ / : * ? " < > |

kind.unknown: The current UI pack has no "{kind}" component, so this item is not shown.

pack.idMismatch: The id "{id}" in pack.json does not match the folder name "{folder}".
pack.duplicateId: The id "{id}" is used more than once.
pack.formatTooNew: This UI pack uses format {format}, which is newer than the supported format {supported}. Update TRM Live UI first.
pack.formatTooOld: This UI pack uses format {format}, which is too old. The oldest supported format is {supported}.
pack.requiresEngine: This UI pack needs TRM Live UI v{required} or later. This is v{engine}.
pack.madeWithNewer: This UI pack was made with the newer v{madeWith}. This is v{engine}, so some effects may differ.
pack.unreadable: The UI pack cannot be read: {message}
pack.exists: A UI pack with the id "{id}" already exists.
pack.builtinConflict: "{id}" has the same id as a built-in UI pack and cannot be imported. Change the id in pack.json.
pack.notRemovable: "{id}" is a built-in UI pack and cannot be deleted.
pack.importUnusable: UI pack "{id}" has problems and cannot be imported.
pack.componentApiTooNew: This UI pack needs component API v{required}. This program supports v{supported}. Update TRM Live UI first.

zip.invalid: The file is not a valid zip, or it is damaged.
zip.unsupported: This kind of zip is not supported (encrypted, split or very large files).
zip.tooLarge: The zip is too large or has too many files.
zip.noManifest: No pack.json was found in the zip.
